admission.justification: An unnamed or duplicated wait owner can hang a suite or let a racy rewrite case claim a source change it never made.

applicability: Shared condition-wait helpers and tests needing a same-second Git-index rewrite.
conditions: The unmet predicate or operation is named on the common hang guard failure.
The index rewrite has one canonical helper; its alignment guard is separately bounded at120seconds.
exclusions: Deliberately expiring product guards and injected clocks remain distinct from hang guards.

evidence: Python timing scan; tests in reopen/read-latency/candidate-capture import the canonical helper

statement: Condition waits fail with a named unmet condition under one hang guard, and the same-second index rewrite has one time-bounded owner.
